name: Lost Promises: the defender deals 3 to the attacking unit and ends the combat phase
notes: Alice Bonus is active (Alice, Golden Queen in the champion's lineage). Player 1 answers player 2's Dungeon Guide attack with Lost Promises from hand: the attacker takes 3 damage (and is destroyed) and the combat phase ends. The handler used the attacker-relative CombatAttacker variable unconverted, so the defending player's copy never hit anything.

rulesClauses: [Alice Bonus] Deal 3 damage to target attacking unit, then end the combat phase.

engineBug.summary: FIXED. Lost Promises damaged the wrong object when used by the defending player.
